pages.text: Villagers here are people, not vending machines. $(bold)Villager Comfort$() means a villager without a bed, light and food trades badly; a happy village trades well.$(br2)$(bold)Restock Balance$() means trades run out and restock slowly. Buying out one librarian all day does not work.

Together they make trading halls pointless and towns valuable: the best prices are in a real village with real beds, and the way to more trade is $(bold)more villages$(), not more cells.$(br2)Villages grow (Village Expansion) and hire guards. Villager Workers can be put to farming or hauling.
